name: Pennsylvania

fees.note: Single trip general issuance fee, up to 14' wide (manufactured/modular housing $53).
Single trip general issuance fee over 14' wide (manufactured/modular housing $103).
$0.04 per ton-mile on weight over the registered (or legal, whichever is less) gross. PennDOT rounds the excess UP to whole tons; this line uses exact tons.

Super load preliminary application fee $68 + $12 per county on the route (fee sheet 7/1/2025). Also applies to super loads by width (>16') or length (>160'). State Police escort costs invoiced separately.

escorts.when: Over 13' wide, on interstates and freeways
Over 13' wide, on two-lane and other roads

police.text: 1 police escort. Super load (>16' wide): State Police escort or CEVO in lieu of PSP; number set by PSP/permit; cost invoiced separately.
1 police escort. Super load (>160' long): State Police escort or CEVO in lieu of PSP.
1 police escort. Super load (>201,000 lb): State Police escort or CEVO in lieu of PSP.

restrictions.text: No movement sunset to sunrise, Saturday after 12 noon, Sunday, or on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas and the day before each of these holidays (unless the permit says otherwise).
Same restricted travel periods apply to all permitted moves, overweight included: no sunset-sunrise, Saturday after noon, Sunday, or holiday / day-before-holiday travel.

Urbanized areas (listed on Form M-938): movement only 3:00-7:30 AM, 9:00 AM-4:00 PM and 7:00 PM-sunset, 7 days a week (except holiday periods); 9 AM-4 PM only through Fort Pitt, Squirrel Hill and Liberty tunnels. Moves between 3 AM and sunrise need extra lighting and front and rear pilot cars.
Over 14'6": notify affected public utilities at least 24 hours before the move to arrange relocation of wires.
No convoys within 1,000 ft of another permitted oversize vehicle; pull over if more than six vehicles back up behind the load. No travel in snow/ice, visibility under 1,000 ft, or high wind.

travel.weekends: No travel Saturday afternoon or Sunday
travel.holidays: No travel the day before or on the holiday

travel.weekends: No travel Saturday afternoon or Sunday
travel.holidays: No travel the day before or on the holiday

notes: Single-trip permit valid for 5 authorized weekdays. PennDOT permits cover state highways only; local roads need local permission and the Pennsylvania Turnpike is separate.
Overweight above 136,000 lb gross or Table 8-1/8-2 limits needs supplemental application M-936AS (3 work days); super loads need a preliminary application at least 3 weeks ahead.
Pilot cars also required for overweight moves restricted to reduced speed or single-vehicle bridge crossings (set on the permit), and for vehicles that cannot hold 40 mph on limited-access highways.
PennDOT published fee sheets effective July 2021, 2023 and 2025; recheck for a newer sheet.
Pub 31 (route survey > 14'6") is a 2008 manual; confirm the survey rule still applies.
